jurisdictions.name: England
jurisdictions.document: School Teachers' Pay and Conditions Document 2025 and guidance on school teachers' pay and conditions
jurisdictions.next_edition_note: Draft STPCD 2026 (consultation to 2026-09-23, expected in force Nov 2026) proposes INSET days on a time-equivalent basis (twilights/half-days); 1265/195 not proposed to change. Re-verify when published.

part_time.fte_basis: hours employed in the school's timetabled teaching week / total hours in that week (para 40.1(a)); STTW = time pupils are normally taught (40.1(b)); guidance para 81: excludes break duty, registration, assemblies
part_time.days_rule: not numerically pro-rated; cannot be required on days/part-days not normally worked (51.9; guidance 85)

breaks.morning_break_note: Document silent; NASUWT guidance: timetabled morning/afternoon breaks count as directed time

excluded_roles: unattached teacher paid as headteacher or leadership group
jurisdictions.residential_note: 51.3: 195-day rule does not apply to full-time teachers wholly/mainly in residential establishments
